It was first released in Japan on the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on October 2, 2024. ==Blurb== ==Plot== A young girl, who appears to be a fan of {{p|Wooper}} (as evidence by her hairclips matching Wooper's gills and her carrying around a Wooper plushie), seems to be looking for an outbreak of Wooper but happens upon a [[mass outbreak]] of {{rf|Paldean}} Wooper and {{p|Clodsire}}. Initially, she is shocked and scared of the [[regional form]]s, but they notice her Wooper plushie and accept her into the group.
